name: What types of door frames are available for installation?

mainEntity.name: What types of door frames are available for installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Door frames come in various materials and styles, each suited for different applications. Common types include wood frames, which offer classic aesthetics and good insulation; metal frames, known for their durability and security, often used in commercial settings; and fiberglass frames, which are low-maintenance and resistant to rot or insects. Pre-hung door units include the frame, door, and hinges, simplifying installation. The best choice depends on the door's location, desired security, and aesthetic preferences for your Bay Area property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common door frame types include wood, metal, and fiberglass, each offering different benefits for durability, aesthetics, and maintenance.
